summary: All three tracers (arch-ratchet, reader-inventory, seam-authority) are seeded stubs with no findings appended during implement, so the mission recorded no friction/approach/decision evidence.
root_cause: Tracers seeded at planning but never back-filled during implement; no gate checks tracer content
suggested_fix: Add a lightweight content check (non-empty Entries) at review/accept, or have the tracer-append command prompt per WP

summary: Tracer names deviate from the canonical tooling-friction/approach/design-decisions trio (topic-named tracers instead).
suggested_fix: Normalise tracer file names or document topic tracers as allowed extras

summary: test_every_load_delivery goes locally false-red because of ambient context-state.json leaking into the test.
root_cause: Test reads ambient per-checkout context-state.json rather than an isolated fixture
suggested_fix: Fixed in-mission as FR-009 (isolate state)

summary: Full tests/architectural/ runs break the agent session, forcing targeted node-id runs only.
root_cause: Architectural suite too heavy for the harness session budget
suggested_fix: Use targeted node-ids; keep arch suite sharded

summary: Bare python/pytest inside a lane worktree imports PRIMARY checkout src, not the lane's code.
root_cause: Editable install .pth points at the main checkout
suggested_fix: Always use uv run (or PYTHONPATH=<lane>/src) in lanes

summary: Org monthly spend limit was terminating dispatched subagents in sibling sessions.
suggested_fix: Watch for dispatch terminations; budget-aware fan-out

summary: Delivery/reachability must be asserted on the profile channel (profile_channel_reachable), not resolve_context, which is the action channel and is vacuously green/permanently red for profile seeds.
root_cause: Plan named the wrong channel; post-plan squad caught it
suggested_fix: Assert on the channel where the FR is genuinely red->green

summary: Work item IC-06 had to be split (IC-06a parallel / IC-06b sequenced) because Protocol typing edits collided with the core-walk hunks in context.py.
root_cause: Parallel-labelled WP touched the same hunks as another WP
suggested_fix: Check hunk-level overlap, not just file-level, before marking WPs parallel

summary: Baseline deferred-set figures (50/39) in planning inputs were stale; the true baseline was 60.
root_cause: Brief figures copied from earlier slice without re-measuring
suggested_fix: Re-measure baselines at plan time

summary: FR-007 C4 templates delivered via a template:instantiates edge riding the suggests-walk; anti-patterns reuse the existing REJECTS relation and are deliberately non-delivered, avoiding a second traversal authority.
Approach and friction tracers only contain the planning seed entry; no implement-time entries were appended.
Agents appending tracer findings from a lane commit kitty-specs/ changes on the lane branch, which blocks later move-task (the barrier this WP targets).
root_cause: TRACER_FILE is COORD-classified but only has a reader; no routed writer existed
suggested_fix: Build lane-origin tracer-append command routed via write_target(TRACER_FILE)+commit_for_mission

summary: A blank agent:"" annotation silently blanks attribution because the reducer only guards `is not None`.
root_cause: Reducer null-check does not treat empty string as missing
suggested_fix: Reject/guard blank actor in tracer-append

summary: Tracer writer must not use the read_dir(RETROSPECTIVE) short-circuit or it recurses (Ledger-M16).
root_cause: read_dir short-circuit sits above the new writer
suggested_fix: Call the leaf/write_target directly

summary: WP10 baseline capture recorded a synthetic failure: no JUnit XML artifact produced by the scoped run.
root_cause: Gate-coverage scoped baseline run produced no junit artifact
suggested_fix: Treat missing-artifact as 'no measurement' distinct from a test failure

summary: Tracer writes should go through a dedicated tracer-append CLI (--mission --category --entry --actor) that is idempotent and routes to coord.
suggested_fix: Ship spec-kitty agent tracer-append

summary: agent action implement cut a lane from a stale base predating the mission's own acceptance pins, giving a false 0-failure baseline.
root_cause: Lane allocation base does not include the mission branch's latest commits
suggested_fix: Merge mission branch into fresh lane before measuring; tooling should cut lanes from current mission tip

summary: The --to done gate requires every issue in issue-matrix.md to be terminal, so no WP in a multi-WP mission can reach done; --force and --done-override-reason do not bypass it.
root_cause: done gate is mission-scoped (issue matrix) but applied per-WP
suggested_fix: Scope the issue-matrix check to the WP's own issues or allow override-with-reason

summary: Lane guard rejects kitty-specs/ writes from lanes; no WP declared test files in owned_files, so every red-first commit tripped ACTIVE_WP_SCOPE_VIOLATION, and fixes had to be reapplied after finalize regenerated frontmatter.
root_cause: owned_files generation omits test files; spec-kitty tasks regenerates frontmatter overwriting manual amendments
suggested_fix: Include test files in owned_files by default; preserve manual ownership amendments across regen

summary: analysis-report.md hashes inputs, so any remediation edit invalidates it and blocks implement until re-recorded.
suggested_fix: Batch remediation before re-analysis

summary: Pre-review regression gate (--to for_review) times out at a 300s cap on a ~2 min suite and refuses the transition.
root_cause: Fixed 300s cap too tight for scoped suites under load
suggested_fix: Make the cap configurable/scale with scope; distinguish timed_out from failure

summary: Bulk-edit inference false-positive (4/4 score) because the spec discusses a schema migration, requiring --acknowledge-not-bulk-edit on every lane allocation.
suggested_fix: Persist the acknowledgement once per mission

summary: Concurrent implementers sharing one working tree: orchestrator's git add -A swallowed another agent's uncommitted source edits into a dossier-only commit (2e6aa1d78f).
root_cause: git add -A is index-wide; disjoint file sets do not make a shared index safe
suggested_fix: Never git add -A in shared checkouts; give each concurrent implementer its own lane worktree

summary: Concurrent pytest sessions over tests/sync and tests/cli produce 16 false reds because daemon tests pgrep/port-scan and reap each other's daemons.
root_cause: Tests reason about machine state (ports/processes) rather than their own fixtures
suggested_fix: Partition port range / SPEC_KITTY_HOME per shard; do not parallelise those paths on one machine

summary: tests/sync/conftest.py blanket 'assume consenting checkout' fixture is guarded by filename tokens, so it can silently neutralise pins in files not matching 'consent'/'capture_gate'.
root_cause: Guard enumerates filename substrings instead of test-declared opt-in
suggested_fix: Replace filename-token guard with a marker/explicit opt-in keyed on what the test patches

summary: Negative (absence-of-egress) pins passed for the wrong reason because a sibling test closed the asyncio loop, making publishes fail and be caught.
root_cause: asyncio.get_event_loop() shared across tests; order-dependent infra failure indistinguishable from refusal
suggested_fix: Own the event loop per test; for absence assertions ask what else could produce absence

summary: WPs added after planning (WP12) have no lanes.json entry and default to lane-a; the lane-staleness gate then advises rebasing WP01's approved lane, forcing --force.
root_cause: lanes.json written once at planning; no registration path for post-planning WPs
suggested_fix: Register post-planning WPs in lanes.json or fail loudly on unmappable WPs

summary: Pre-review regression gate prints 'no_coverage — skipping the gate cheaply' for WPs whose work landed on the mission branch, so two confidentiality WPs got zero gate coverage while output read like a pass.
root_cause: Gate diffs the WP's lane worktree; no lane means no changed files
suggested_fix: Fall back to diffing owned_files against merge base; never print a skip like a pass

summary: Run verification baselines in a throwaway git worktree pinned to a commit rather than the tree being edited.
root_cause: Measuring and changing the same tree
suggested_fix: Throwaway worktree at target commit, copy only files under test

summary: Dead-symbol gate (test_no_dead_symbols.py) is blind to attributes reached via getattr(obj, 'name', None) strings, e.g. never-assigned _ws_client.
root_cause: AST-based liveness treats string attribute access as non-reference
suggested_fix: Extend scanner to getattr string literals or flag never-assigned attributes

summary: Mutation plugins rot (3 of 5 obsolete); require each plugin to assert it took effect and to patch the primary decision point; read failure text over tallies.
root_cause: Architecture moved; patched symbol renamed or made redundant; TypeErrors mistaken for kills
suggested_fix: Mutations must fail loudly if target absent and report per-site bind splits

summary: A textually clean rebase (lint clean, no conflict markers) crashed at runtime with TypeErrors; __all__ conflicts had no correct side.
root_cause: Semantic divergence of signatures across branches
suggested_fix: Run the product after merges; recompute __all__ from verified importers in merged tree

summary: New mission tripped the dogfood birth invariant (status_phase missing) and backfill-runtime-state wrote the field while reporting 'Flipped: 0 / Skipped (already migrated): 1'; field written as string "1".
root_cause: Missions born after event log never get status_phase seeded; backfill summary folds flip into skipped bucket
suggested_fix: Set status_phase at mission create; fix backfill summary reporting; write integer

summary: pytest | tail reports tail's exit status; a killed pipeline produced an empty file (no measurement) that could be misread as pass/fail.
suggested_fix: Write output to file or check PIPESTATUS; quote the count line as evidence

summary: 20+ concurrent pytest processes across five agents produced false reds (exhausted port band, leaked daemon, 7m25s runs) indistinguishable from regressions.
root_cause: Parallel full-suite runs on one machine; leaked 12-hour-old daemon
suggested_fix: Fan out coding, serialise sweeps; per-case SPEC_KITTY_HOME; kill leaked daemons

summary: Coordinator misattributed an exit 143 killed run to contention; it was the agent's own timeout SIGTERM.
root_cause: Plausible documented hazard substituted for verification
suggested_fix: Check elapsed vs timeout; treat killed run as no measurement and re-run narrowed

summary: Loop-driving tests hang instead of failing because pytest.ini registers the timeout marker but sets no default timeout in addopts.
suggested_fix: Set default timeout in addopts or mark loop tests; assert termination via call counters

summary: Editable install .pth hard-codes the main checkout's src path, so pytest in a throwaway worktree silently imports the live tree, making isolation look performed while it is not.
suggested_fix: Always set PYTHONPATH=$WT/src or create a dedicated venv inside the worktree

summary: A mutation was inert on local Python 3.14 but the targeted branch is live on CI's 3.11/3.12 (Path.exists EACCES handling differs).
suggested_fix: Target interpreter-stable primitives (os.stat); treat zero-invocation as environment difference, not dead code

summary: Probing _gate_coverage's CompiledGate.selects() directly reported 0 gates for a known-covered file; the probe was invalid without real collection.
suggested_fix: Positive-control any diagnostic probe against a known case

summary: Tests pinned a production behaviour that never existed (_ws_client factory); two of three passed for the wrong reason.
root_cause: Tests set an attribute production never assigns
suggested_fix: When correct state is absence, pin absence with an inverted live pin

summary: Three tests in tests/sync/test_runtime.py assert the pre-fix default-allow and are green only thanks to the conftest guard gap; fixing the guard would tempt reverting T028.
suggested_fix: Reconcile these tests before replacing the guard with a marker

summary: reset_adapters() in a propagator fixture teardown cleared the global consent-resolver registry, deterministically failing later suites' positive controls with a domain-true refusal message.
root_cause: Fixture resets process-global registry to empty instead of restoring
suggested_fix: Fixtures mutating global state must restore what they found; mission runs used -p no:randomly which hid ordering

summary: A full tests/architectural run died with INTERNALERROR FileNotFoundError on a scratch file another agent created/deleted mid-scan.
root_cause: Collection walks a tree other agents mutate
suggested_fix: Run arch sweeps in an isolated worktree

summary: Consolidated rule: a shared working tree is not a measurement substrate; measure every claim in a worktree pinned to a commit and narrow scope rather than raising timeouts.
suggested_fix: Codify as standing practice for multi-agent missions

summary: Both main and mission branch regenerated the derived ci_topology_census.json / _gate_coverage.py independently; a textual merge can match neither derivation.
root_cause: Derived artifact committed and merged textually
suggested_fix: Regenerate census with --emit-census after merge and confirm no-op

summary: #3030 and saas#585 mis-pinned the root cause at sync/batch.py:1064; the real drain was delivery/dispatcher.py:_select_undelivered, so a fix at the reported site would have passed unit tests and leaked.
root_cause: Issue reports pinned the wrong code path
suggested_fix: Trace the live production path before fixing a reported site

summary: RETIRED_DRAIN_NAMES guard is two literal names: catches literal restoration but misses any new queue-backed sender (drain_queue + urlopen).
suggested_fix: Key guard on drain_queue/process_batch_results readers reaching a network sink

summary: Two inert cwd-derived reads survive in batch.py (queue_event pooling, _is_checkout_sync_enabled_for_batch); FR-014 restoring a queue-backed sender would make both live cross-project consent decisions; deliberately not filed as issues.
Grep for fail-open patterns as a class: `is False` tri-state checks, truthiness on falsy values, match without default, and dict.get(key, PERMISSIVE_DEFAULT) on policy tables.
suggested_fix: Add a pattern audit / lint for permissive-default lookups

summary: Residual holes left open: mis-spelled consent key (enabledd) voids refusal; identity absence plus a grant still captures with project_uuid=None.
root_cause: No closed whitelist of sync.* keys (forward-compat)

summary: Op envelopes carry no project_uuid; project is derived from checkout locality, which becomes a cross-project substitution if a daemon ever sweeps other projects' Op records.
suggested_fix: Envelope schema change becomes mandatory if the locality precondition breaks

summary: register_sync_routing_resolver renamed to register_egress_consent_resolver; the prior integration-boundary mission dossier documents the old names and should not later read as drift.
Machine-wide denial from one unreadable checkout config contradicts FR-020 rationale and is not resolvable within consent/config/routing.
Pre-spec squad found three of four P0s in the brief (#2160, #2367, #1834, #2573) already had their stated asks delivered; scope was rewritten, shrinking roughly by half.
root_cause: Brief drawn from stale tracker prose
suggested_fix: Re-ground a brownfield cluster against the code before specifying

summary: #1834 reproduces identically on flat SINGLE_BRANCH missions, so the axis is 'which surface a gate judges', not coord topology; coord-conditioned fixes forbidden (C-004).
suggested_fix: Frame gate fixes by judged surface

summary: #2795 claim-time consolidation blocker: _ensure_vcs_in_meta writes the VCS lock into PRIMARY meta.json and advance_branch_ref's _dirty_entries misclassifies it as destructive, raising RefAdvanceDirtyWorktreeError; reported cause (dirty coord meta.json) was refuted.
root_cause: Tool-authored metadata left uncommitted on primary; dirty-scan too strict
suggested_fix: Classify vcs-lock-only meta.json change as non-destructive churn and drop it at resync

summary: Implementer confined to lane worktree cannot write mission tracers: writing kitty-specs/ in the lane makes move-task --to for_review refuse; tracer files left uncommitted in the lane tree needing operator migration.
root_cause: No implementer-available seam to route a mission-dir write from a lane to the planning/coord branch
suggested_fix: Provide a planning-artifact / tracer commit seam callable from a lane

summary: mission create --pr-bound wrote pr_bound: true to meta.json and left it uncommitted, dirtying the tree within minutes.
root_cause: Tool metadata written at lifecycle steps without committing (#2795 shape)
suggested_fix: Commit tool-authored metadata atomically or own it via a transaction

summary: spec-kitty spec-commit refused a directory argument with a truncated backstop message suggesting `git checkout HEAD -- <paths>`, which could destroy uncommitted work.
root_cause: spec-commit does not expand directory args; misleading remediation text
suggested_fix: Accept directories; remove destructive suggestion

summary: mission-tracer-files.procedure.yaml says create `traces/` but all five existing tracer missions use `tracers/`.
suggested_fix: Correct the procedure to one spelling

summary: test_tid251_enforcement.py fails locally: .venv/bin/python has no ruff module; test shells out to `python -m ruff` while ruff resolves only via uv run.
root_cause: Test invokes python -m ruff; ruff not installed into venv
suggested_fix: Invoke ruff via the resolved tool path or declare it in test extras

summary: freshen_adr_inventory.py and docs_index.py need PYTHONPATH=. but the ADR README documents bare invocation; freshening does not refresh the docs index so check_docs_freshness --ci stays red (DOCS-INDEX-DRIFT).
suggested_fix: Fix scripts to run bare and chain index refresh

summary: mission create wrote coordination_branch and created the branch but never materialised the coord worktree; status.events.jsonl sat untracked on primary for a full planning cycle; doctor coordination detects it but nothing runs it automatically.
root_cause: Bootstrap skipped coord worktree creation; detector never invoked in lifecycle
suggested_fix: Materialise coord worktree at create; run doctor coordination automatically at lifecycle steps

summary: A gate that exists but is never invoked is indistinguishable from no gate; deferred invariants must disclose their contract at assignment because consumer repos lack this project's CI check.
suggested_fix: Tool should state at assignment 'the loop will not verify this; here is the gate you need'

summary: Post-consolidation verification is enforced by a PR CI consistency check, not the mission loop, because the acceptance matrix's sole reader runs pre-consolidation (circular enforcer).
review/pre_review_gate.py dropped from scope because a concurrent sibling mission (scopesource-gate-followup) was deleting ~450 LoC from it.
root_cause: Concurrent missions overlapping on same file
suggested_fix: Check sibling missions' owned files before scoping

summary: 'Deferred to merge' was ambiguous across three merge senses; renamed to post-consolidation (CONSOLIDATED surface).
suggested_fix: Always name the merge sense

summary: NFR-005 accept --diagnose baseline: flat 4.5s dominated by cold import warm-up vs 0.088s warm coord; compare warm steady-state only.
suggested_fix: Measure warm invocation for latency NFRs

summary: synthesized_drg permanently stuck 'stale' because freshness compared a frozen manifest created_at against bundle mtime that advances on any git op.
root_cause: mtime is not a reliable freshness signal; #1912/#1913 no-op write suppression froze created_at
suggested_fix: Content-identity bundle_content_hash compared at read time

summary: charter activate/deactivate mutate config.yaml but do not rewrite bundle files until a later sync, so activation changes are invisible to the content hash until recompile (pre-existing, deferred).
root_cause: Activation writes config but not bundle
suggested_fix: File a future issue for activate->recompile coupling

summary: finalize-tasks hard-rejects any owned_files entry under kitty-specs/ (even another mission's contract doc) and empty owned_files fails compute_lanes, so a doc-deliverable WP cannot honestly declare ownership.
suggested_fix: Allow declaring a kitty-specs/ doc as a reviewer-attested non-owned artifact

summary: C-011 per-WP red->green forced a 5-WP->4-WP restructure because a dedicated 'red tests' WP stayed red until later WPs.
root_cause: ATDD instinct to author all red tests upfront conflicts with per-WP self-contained red->green
suggested_fix: Decompose layered fixes by smallest self-contained red->green slice

summary: DIRTY_WORKTREE recorder strictness forces reasoning around unrelated cruft (stray kitty-ops/*.jsonl, sibling mission dirs) in repo-wide git status.
suggested_fix: Provide a per-mission scoped status view

summary: Cross-fork missions cannot assign the HiC on upstream issues (DIR-003 best-effort), recurring on every cross-fork mission.
single_branch topology mission still had lanes.json computed with four lanes and sparse-checkout lane worktrees materialised, left orphaned for manual pruning.
suggested_fix: Skip lane computation for single_branch or auto-teardown lane worktrees

summary: synthesize() tests without repo_root= defaulted to Path.cwd() and wrote real artifacts into the project's .kittify/ on every broad test run.
root_cause: Pipeline entry point defaults repo_root to cwd
suggested_fix: Lint tests for missing repo_root= on repo_root-accepting entry points

summary: mypy --strict single-file vs full-package invocation disagree: casts needed under follow_imports=skip read as redundant-cast in full-package mode.
root_cause: follow_imports=skip for charter.* in single-file mode
suggested_fix: Treat full-package run as authoritative; do not 'fix' the casts

summary: Shared charter_preflight _fixtures.py hand-wrote pre-fix manifests, breaking three test dirs (other CI shards) after merge that local sweeps missed.
root_cause: Shared fixture encodes a schema/contract shape; sweeps only co-located suite
suggested_fix: Grep every importer of a shared fixture across tests/ when contract changes; run all affected shards

summary: Root cause of two post-plan BLOCKERs was duplicated dict-hash-then-construct logic across four manifest persist sites; fixed structurally with one finalize_manifest.
suggested_fix: Single canonical finalizer

summary: Schema version bump staged in two steps to avoid accidental RED (instance '3' hashed over '2') indistinguishable from real regressions.
FR-007 external contract doc edit has no automated pin (kitty-specs prose doc), only reviewer attestation.
root_cause: No gate for kitty-specs contract docs

summary: Per-WP 'append notes here' placeholders for WP01-WP03 were never filled; only the WP04 closeout assessment populated the tracers.
root_cause: Implementers did not append during implement

summary: Every new test file trips BOTH gate-coverage baselines (gc3b orphan --update-baseline and gc2b selection --freeze-baselines) even when nothing selected changes; architectural-only files re-froze byte-identical baselines.
root_cause: gc2b exact-selection ratchet pins shape and over-fires on routine test add/remove
suggested_fix: Re-scope gc2b to genuine orphans (done WP15); consider same for gc3b total_tests

summary: New tests/architectural/*.py files need a _arch_shard_map.py row or the completeness guard fails.
suggested_fix: Auto-derive shard membership or make registration a single seam (register())

summary: Arch marker/gate runs are vacuous under .worktrees/; gates must be verified from the primary checkout.
root_cause: Gate path logic excludes worktree paths
suggested_fix: Make arch gates worktree-aware or fail loudly when vacuous

summary: In a clone/lane, bare python/pytest imports the PRIMARY src; fresh lane venvs lack pytest/ruff/mypy until `uv sync --extra test --extra lint --group dev` ('Audited 54 packages' false no-op).
root_cause: Editable .pth to primary; test/lint tools in optional extras not default deps
suggested_fix: Put test/lint tooling in the dev group synced by default; always uv run

summary: kitty-specs/ edits (incl. tracer files) committed inside a lane worktree can block move-task; agents repeatedly edited tracers from lanes on orchestrator instruction, requiring reconciliation.
root_cause: Lane-branch kitty-specs guard; no tracer write seam from lanes
suggested_fix: Provide a routed tracer-append seam

summary: Terminology and some integration/git gates run only in CI's integration-tests-core-misc shard, so local runs miss them.
suggested_fix: Run tests/architectural and terminology guard locally before push

summary: A background status daemon may auto-commit staged files with the previous mission's message.
suggested_fix: Commit promptly; reword stray commits

summary: move-task can hang on sync-daemon fan-out; workaround is backgrounding + SPEC_KITTY_SYNC_MINIMAL_IMPORT=1.
No git stash in lane worktrees: the shared stash stack steals a sibling lane's WIP.
root_cause: git stash is repo-global across worktrees
suggested_fix: Trust committed HEAD; never stash in lanes

summary: F12: move-task run from a lane worktree committed status.events.jsonl/status.json onto the lane branch (3x) while printing 'Using planning repo's kitty-specs', then the next call hard-blocks on its own guard.
root_cause: Write path does not route status commits to planning branch on lanes topology; guard is lagging not preventive
suggested_fix: move-task should refuse or auto-redirect kitty-specs writes to the planning branch

summary: move-task from a lane rejected 'Illegal transition: planned -> for_review' because read_current_wp_state_transactional read the lane's stale local status.events.jsonl; same command from primary succeeded.
root_cause: Transactional status read path does not route through planning/primary partition for lanes topology
suggested_fix: Unconditionally route status reads/writes through the planning partition

summary: F13: ~81 pre-existing failures across tests/cli, auth, doctor, dashboard, missions from --json output JSONDecodeError and Rich ANSI styling splitting expected substrings.
root_cause: Likely rich version change affecting CliRunner output serialization
suggested_fix: File a follow-up; strip ANSI / force no-color in CliRunner tests

summary: A self-checking mypy test fails with 'No module named mypy' because mypy is only in --extra lint, not --extra test.
Harness auto-backgrounds slow foreground pytest; tests/runtime (604 tests) ~10 min and tests/specify_cli (10995) ~10.5 min, forcing Monitor loops and scoped runs.
root_cause: Heavy seam suites driving real engines
suggested_fix: Scoped-file iteration + one final full run

summary: WP task tables and DoD greps mis-counted the patch surface (~241 vs 23 real sites); single-line grep misses multi-line monkeypatch.setattr calls.
root_cause: Loose grep-based estimates in WP prompts
suggested_fix: Use AST/DOTALL-aware scans for DoD survivor counts

summary: Deleting 'dead' runtime_bridge helpers identified by grep went RED because a frozen compat-surface guard asserts identity via a name-list variable grep cannot see; 0 of 45 deletable at WP02.
root_cause: Static grep classification blind to list-driven identity assertions
suggested_fix: Use the frozen guard's coverage set as the deletability signal

summary: Wiring a new liveness detector into the shared dead-symbol pipeline immediately reds the stale-allowlist ratchet while the WP was forbidden from touching allowlist rows; required an unwired overlay and coordinated fold in WP05.
root_cause: Two-direction ratchet (offender/stale) forces atomic co-landing of detector + row removal
suggested_fix: Land detector and allowlist row removal in the same commit

summary: 34 runtime_bridge REACH-entangled forwarding delegates plus 7 un-repointed consumer bindings deferred; deletion requires relaxing the frozen #2531 compat guard.
root_cause: Frozen closed-loop compat-surface guard couples delegates to wiring sentinels
suggested_fix: Separate #2531-co-owned follow-up to retire round-trip sentinels

summary: WP05's 'grandfathered burndown' DoD assumed removable material that a mid-mission re-sequencing eliminated; category B stayed at 193, risking being read as a missed obligation.
root_cause: WP prompt premises stale after mid-mission re-sequencing
suggested_fix: Refresh WP prompts after re-sequencing

summary: Operator hypothesis catalogued: mass-added ratchet/parity suites are mostly scaffold-friction; discriminator keeps only tests pinning behavioural/negative invariants.
suggested_fix: Close-out keep/consolidate/retire verdicts feed a follow-up mission

summary: Golden-count ban guard's per-directory ceiling cannot catch a same-landing swap (convert one site, regrow another in the same dir); tests/specify_cli 262 convert sites deferred.
root_cause: Count-ceiling baseline chosen to avoid positional-anchor ban
suggested_fix: Review is second line of defence; follow-up #2625

summary: ~60% of the original briefing was already shipped; #2295's '17 quarantines' was stale (actual 1).
suggested_fix: Recount before scoping

summary: Concurrent append collisions on tracer-design-decisions.md across lanes were safe only because agents re-read before write.
suggested_fix: Re-read before append; prefer an append command

summary: create_mission_core's worktree guard checks process cwd not explicit repo_root, rejecting test-factory mission creation from inside a lane worktree.
suggested_fix: Added allow_worktree_context seam

summary: All three tracers (claim-liveness, emit-class-closure, subtask-row-canon) have empty Implementation log and Close-out assessment sections; only planning intent was recorded.
FR-008 (allocator-side liveness consumer) was withdrawn post-tasks because the lane allocator has no stale-claim decision.
root_cause: Spec assumed a consumer that does not exist

summary: _infer_subtasks_complete fails open and does not read the primary surface at all four callers; #2511 per-door patch must only be removed after status_transition.py:444 is fixed or the orchestrator door re-opens.
root_cause: Per-door patch instead of class closure
suggested_fix: Fix all callers via resolve_planning_read_dir then retire door patch

summary: Two divergent subtask-row walks in core/subtask_rows.py disagree on section-exit semantics (break vs continue), so guard, dashboard and rollback may disagree on what a WP subtask row is.
suggested_fix: One canonical _walk_wp_section; guard's break semantic wins

summary: Liveness must reuse the single psutil _is_process_alive helper, never a parallel os.kill/PID parse, and never raise on absent/dead/recycled PID.
suggested_fix: Centralise liveness helper

summary: All three tracers contain only planning seed hypotheses; 'Append during implement' and 'Assess at close' sections were never filled.
Dead-code allowlist keyed by location is not relocation-tolerant; a frozen collision split would silently re-blind a future byte-identical same-name pair (GateDecision-collapse vector).
root_cause: Frozen collision set instead of live recomputation
suggested_fix: Re-derive collision set each run; fail closed on >=2 live resolutions

summary: Spike SymbolKey lacks an AnnAssign branch (14 constants), re-introducing the T001 bug; ~100+ re-export/facade entries forfeit relocation tolerance by design.
~40 arch/integration-suite warnings, near-all intentional warnings.warn report-only diagnostics, pollute the suite output.
root_cause: warnings used as a reporting channel
suggested_fix: Change channel to record_property/log or register expected; no blanket filterwarnings

summary: terminology-guard.toolguide.yaml fails pydantic extra_forbidden on references, so src/doctrine/base.py silently skips an invalid toolguide.

suggested_fix: Validate owned_files globs at finalize

summary: finalize-tasks rejects net-new owned_files unless declared in create_intent, which the WP-prompt template does not prompt for.
suggested_fix: WP template should prompt for create_intent for net-new files

summary: Dropping a frontmatter field required editing a schema-owning module (_inventory.py) outside the WP's ownership; schema owners not surfaced when planning field changes.
finalize-tasks / record-analysis --json output is Rich-wrapped, so json.load fails; agents grep fields instead.
suggested_fix: Enforce a --json-means-pure-json contract

summary: map-requirements reformats WP frontmatter (reorders keys, adds default fields), surprising diffs.
spec-kitty next reports discovery/not_started for a fully-tasked mission because the runtime state machine is separate from agent-command planning.
suggested_fix: Unify or have next read planning state

summary: Any mission-artifact change after analysis (issue-matrix, tracers) stales analysis-report; record-analysis is idempotent so re-running produces no fresher commit; issue-matrix is only forced complete at review (chicken-and-egg).
root_cause: Freshness check covers non-spec artifacts; sha-position guard
suggested_fix: Ignore non-spec/plan/tasks artifacts; add record-analysis --force

summary: Tracers on the planning branch fight per-WP move-task pre-flight and analysis-freshness guards; tracers are coordination-level state and their home should follow coordination authority.
root_cause: Mission-wide append artifact placed on planning surface
suggested_fix: Topology-dependent tracer home (coord branch / primary)

summary: spec-kitty merge squash clobbered newer planning-branch tracer edits with the mission branch's older copy; acceptance-matrix and review artifacts had to be written to both planning checkout and coord worktree.
suggested_fix: Single authoritative home for lifecycle artifacts

summary: Post-spec squad forced a 3-ship split (spec undersized 4-5x; gate cannot self-validate within one merge); report-only-then-blocking rulers; self-test red-first as DoD.
ADR note saying Common Docs skills 'install as peer skills' left mismatched with implementation (shipped as doctrine tactics) until Mission B.
root_cause: Deferred ADR reconciliation to avoid cascading re-merge

summary: Spec's first-pass ADR count (140) was a floor not a measurement (~117 unique / 191 files); always live-count.
